hero_tagline: Fearful faces, screaming panic, spooky ghosts and spiders, and typed D: emoticons: real fright in every intensity. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The scared emoji range runs from a wide-eyed 😨 fearful face to the full-blown terror of 😱 screaming in fear, genuine fright, not the plot-twist surprise of a shocked face. This page gathers every frightened and panicked face, the cold-sweat anxious emojis for nervous dread, the spooky ghost, spider, and bat symbols that set a haunted-house scene, and one-click scared combo sets for chats, comments, horror posts, and Halloween captions. When an emoji won't carry the exact shiver, a typed D: emoticon or a trembling kaomoji like ((((；゜Д゜)))) pastes anywhere plain text works.
